title: Deeper/broader DXF DICTIONARY entry-ownership and FIELD route
mode: Primary-source web research and local plan/source/test reconciliation; plan-only
scope: Separate immediate object ownership, DICTIONARY key-edge kind, dictionary-wide hard-owner policy, and FIELD-internal pointer roles.
Reconcile current Autodesk DXF references with the current ACadRust release/source and LibreDWG release history.
Refine an implementation-ready, fast generated test for the exact ACAD_FIELD extension-dictionary route without promoting support claims.

sources.name: Autodesk current DICTIONARY DXF reference
observations: Group 280 is the dictionary-wide hard-owner flag; the entry-handle row is group 350.
The page permits applications to create/use their own dictionaries, so this table alone does not specify every application-specific edge profile.

sources.name: Autodesk DXF group-code ranges
observations: Group codes 350-359 are soft-owner IDs and 360-369 are hard-owner IDs.

sources.name: Autodesk OBJECTS and FIELD references
observations: The OBJECTS example emits NOD entries as group 350.
FIELD child fields use group 360; expression object IDs use group 331.
Autodesk's developer article distinguishes the NOD ACAD_FIELDLIST entry to FIELDLIST from FIELD objects typically reachable through entity extension dictionaries.

sources.name: Older official Autodesk DXF reference
observations: The NOD text describes associated entry-name pairs as hard-ownership pointer references, which is not a clean match for the current generic DICTIONARY table and OBJECTS example.
limits: The conflict is recorded as version/profile documentation ambiguity; it does not establish that every NOD key must be serialized as group 360.

sources.name: ACadRust release history and current writer source
sources.revision: 0.5.5 changelog published 2026-09-10; current 0.6.5 source surface accessed 2026-10-20
observations: The 0.5.5 changelog states ACAD_FIELD is written with hard-owner code 360 and remaining NOD entries match BricsCAD.
The current 0.6.5 writer source retains per-entry hard-owner state and a canonical ACAD_FIELD exception.

An adjacent source comment generalizes to ACAD_LAYOUT and ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME, but the same mutable source has a BricsCAD audit note requiring the NOD ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME entry as group 350; the broader comment is not adopted as a rule.
limits: No ACadRust binary was installed or run; peer source/docs are comparative evidence, not normative format authority or an interoperability result.

sources.name: LibreDWG current NEWS
observations: Release history includes an older DICTIONARY hard_owner DXF 350/360 fix, demonstrating sensitivity of this serialization area.
limits: The historical note does not specify the current key-by-key output matrix and is not evidence of a current LibreDWG defect.

sources.name: Local libdxfrw source and generated test inventory
sources.revision: Shared worktree inspected 2026-10-20; no code/test changed during this pass
observations: Ordinary DICTIONARY output currently chooses group 360 iff hardOwner == 1, otherwise 350; the reserved regenerated NOD emits group 350 for its entries.
DRW_Dictionary::Entry does not retain per-entry edge kind.
The existing FIELD graph control checks in-memory closure for ACAD_FIELDLIST and ACAD_FIELD routes but does not assert their emitted ASCII/Binary edge codes or strict output readback.
limits: Source inspection and existing generated controls identify a test gap, not a reproduced production failure or external consumer rejection.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-20/7G: treat ACAD_FIELD extension-dictionary entry code as a narrow generated-output candidate, distinct from NOD ACAD_FIELDLIST, generic DICTIONARY flag policy, and FIELD-internal 360/331 links.

PAR-20/7G: preserve the existing generic writer rules until a focused ASCII/Binary output/readback control states the exact key/target/owner contract; do not generalize to ACAD_LAYOUT, ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME, or arbitrary ACAD_* keys.
PAR-20/7G: use existing generated test owners and focused validation only; defer optional exact-version peer comparison to a composed checkpoint.

planChanges: Added a newest-summary entry and a detailed research section separating immediate owner, dictionary key-edge kind, dictionary-wide hard-owner flag, and FIELD-internal edge roles.
Recorded the conflicting official Autodesk documentation surfaces and ACadRust 0.5.5 release note plus current 0.6.5 source behavior without claiming a universal 350/360 rule.
Identified an existing test gap: generated FIELD graph checks validate in-memory closure but not exact emitted ACAD_FIELD versus ACAD_FIELDLIST edge codes or strict readback.
Specified an implementation-ready generated ASCII/Binary matrix and the smallest per-entry/canonical-key change only if the focused control confirms the selected route contract.
Kept counts, support claims, test cadence, fixture policy, and all six deferred external statuses unchanged.
limitations: Autodesk documentation differs across versions/surfaces about hard ownership for NOD entries; this research does not resolve a universal rule.
ACadRust documentation and mutable source contain broader comments that conflict with its release summary and adjacent BricsCAD audit note; only ACAD_FIELD is retained as a candidate.
No generated writer output was executed or inspected during this research-only pass; the candidate is not a confirmed local defect.
No peer, native CAD, external drawing, full suite, or six-item DEFERRED_EXTERNAL qualification was performed.
